newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: No buyers for S.Korea's Hanbo Construction.
newsitem.headline: No buyers for S.Korea's Hanbo Construction.

text.p: No buyers surfaced to take over troubled Hanbo Engineering and Construction on Monday, the deadline set by creditors to sell the unlisted construction unit of failed Hanbo Group, said a spokesman at the Korea First Bank.
"Nobody filed an application to buy the construction company," the spokesman said. "So we are considering selling the company to a designated buyer."
Meanwhile, a Seoul District Court on Monday put the company under protection from its creditors.
Hanbo Engineering faced financial difficulties after Hanbo Group's flagship Hanbo Steel collapsed in January under debts of five trillion won.
